leadReview.originalText: The NetApp ASA r2 systems deliver a unified hardware and software solution that creates a simplified experience specific to the needs of SAN-only customers. On an ASA r2 system, ONTAP software and System Manager are streamlined to provide support for essential SAN functionality while removing features and functions not supported in SAN environments.
